name: Reverse Gravity

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Gravity flips in a 50-foot-radius, 100-foot-high Cylinder: unanchored creatures and objects fall upward.
text: A creature can make a Dexterity save to grab a fixed object within reach and stay put; anything that hits a ceiling takes falling damage, and the rest hovers at the top. Everything falls back down when the spell ends.
